content.text:
To turn off telemetry and background update checks in the Vibe CLI, edit your `~/.vibe/config.toml` file and set:

```toml
enable_telemetry = false
enable_auto_update = false
```

According to the [Update and telemetry settings](https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/cli/configuration#updates-telemetry) documentation:

- `enable_auto_update` controls whether Vibe checks for new releases and updates itself in the background (default: `true`)
- `enable_telemetry` controls telemetry collection (default: `true`)

Note: The documentation recommends keeping `enable_auto_update` enabled so you always run the latest fixes. However, if you're using offline models for privacy reasons, you may want to disable both settings so the CLI doesn't contact external services.
